tab-list-animation.title: Tab List Animation
tab-list-animation.group.timing.desc: When and how fast the tab list opens and closes.
tab-list-animation.group.open_curve.desc: Cubic bezier used when Open Easing is set to Custom Curve.
tab-list-animation.group.close_curve.des: Cubic bezier used when Close Easing is set to Custom Curve.
tab-list-animation.group.scale.desc: Grow the list from the top centre of the screen.
tab-list-animation.group.slide.desc: Move the list in from one side of the screen.
tab-list-animation.group.fade.desc: Fade the whole list in and out.
tab-list-animation.option.enabled.desc: Turn off to get the vanilla instant tab list.
tab-list-animation.option.keyBehaviour.d:
Hold: the list is open while the key is held (vanilla).
Toggle: press once to open, again to close.
tab-list-animation.option.openX1.desc: First control point, time axis (0 to 1).
tab-list-animation.option.openX2.desc: Second control point, time axis (0 to 1).
tab-list-animation.option.closeX1.desc: First control point, time axis (0 to 1).
tab-list-animation.option.closeX2.desc: Second control point, time axis (0 to 1).
tab-list-animation.option.scaleEnabled.d: Grow the list in as it opens.
tab-list-animation.option.scaleFrom.desc: Scale at the start of the animation.
tab-list-animation.option.scaleAxis.desc:
Both: grow evenly.
Horizontal: stretch out sideways.
Vertical: stretch out downwards.
tab-list-animation.option.slideEnabled.d: Slide the list in from a side.
tab-list-animation.option.slideDirection: Which side the list comes in from.
How far the list travels, in GUI pixels.
tab-list-animation.option.fadeEnabled.de: Fade the background, names, heads and ping icons.
